title: propose_child_items arguments
description: Arguments of the agent-service tool `propose_child_items`. Propose a breakdown of the current item into child items of one type. The user reviews each child (accept / edit / reject); approved children are created server-side as children of the current item. Relationship refs are child proposalIds or the parent item id; a parent-child relationship to the parent is created automatically.

rationale.description: Why the item is split this way.

proposalId.description: Identifier of the proposed child, unique within the proposal and different from the parent item id (for example "c1").

markdown.description: The child's full Markdown document (## sections following the child type's template; it is conformed to the template server-side).

sourceRef.description: proposalId of a proposed child, or the parent item id.

targetRef.description: proposalId of a proposed child, or the parent item id.

relationships.description: Optional extra relationships between children or to the parent.
